SynoPkgUptimeKuma **2.5.6-0009**

2.5.6-0009
- Official upstream icon and digest-locked Uptime Kuma 2.5.6 container.
- DSM-managed HTTPS, DSM administrator sign-in, explicit non-admin HTTP 403 and no published container port.
- HTTP monitoring, Socket.IO, data-preserving upgrade, restart and uninstall retention checked on DSM.
- SDK/App 0.17.5, templates 0.17.8, UI 0.12.4; original build inspected with CLI 0.17.7, findings=[].
- Delete-data still retains the Compose named volume; the wizard reports the exact retained name. No ctl interface.

Package: `synopackageland/SynoPkgUptimeKuma`
